screen.fpstune.title: FPS Tune
screen.fpstune.description: Smoother gameplay in busy scenes, by trimming effects you'll barely notice. Press Done to save.
screen.fpstune.advanced.title: FPS Tune: Advanced settings
screen.fpstune.advanced.description: Fine-tune particle admission and Adaptive budget. Dependent controls dim when their parent switch is off. Press Back to return; use Done on the main screen to save.
option.fpstune.enabled.tooltip: Turns everything below on. When off, Minecraft looks and runs exactly as normal. Shortcut: F6.
option.fpstune.profile.help: Profiles set particle and Adaptive options together. Fine-tune them in Advanced settings.
option.fpstune.weather_rendering.tooltip: Show the normal rain and snow effects. Turning this off hides only their local visuals.
option.fpstune.diagnostics_hud.tooltip: Shows, in the corner of your screen, how many particles FPS Tune lets through or holds back right now. Only you can see it.
button.fpstune.advanced.tooltip: Fine-tune particles, weather and the overlay.
option.fpstune.particle_admission.toolti: Fewer sparks, smoke and debris when a lot happens at once. Particles already on screen are never removed.
option.fpstune.max_particles.tooltip: How many new particles can appear at once. Lower means smoother busy scenes, but fights and explosions look thinner.
option.fpstune.nearby_priority.tooltip: When the limit is reached, effects close to you are kept and far-away ones are trimmed first.
option.fpstune.nearby_reserve.tooltip: How many particles near you are always kept when the limit is reached.
option.fpstune.nearby_distance.tooltip: How close to you an effect must be to count as nearby.
option.fpstune.adaptive_budget.tooltip: Slowly raises or lowers the particle limit by itself to stay near your target FPS.
button.fpstune.reset.tooltip: Restore particle and Adaptive settings to their defaults. Basic-screen choices remain unchanged until you press Done.
screen.fpstune.description.off: FPS Tune is off, so nothing below changes your game yet. Turn it on at the top, then press Done.
option.fpstune.profile.balanced.help: Recommended. Most players won't notice a difference.
option.fpstune.profile.smoother_frames.h: Thinner fights and explosions, steadier FPS.
option.fpstune.profile.more_particles.he: Light touch. Only trims the heaviest particle bursts.
option.fpstune.profile.custom.help: You changed individual settings. Pick a profile to start over.
option.fpstune.weather.vanilla.tooltip: Rain and snow look exactly like vanilla.
option.fpstune.weather.reduced.tooltip: Less rain and snow drawn around you, and fewer splashes.
option.fpstune.weather.off.tooltip: No rain or snow is drawn. It still rains in the world and you still hear it.
tab.fpstune.weather.help: This only changes what you see. Weather still happens in the world, and rain and thunder sounds stay the same.
tab.fpstune.display.help: The overlay and the F6 message are only shown on your screen. The overlay hides while a menu is open.
option.fpstune.adaptive_target.tooltip: The FPS the automatic limit aims for. Auto uses the Max Framerate from your video settings.
option.fpstune.adaptive_minimum.tooltip: The automatic limit never goes below this.
option.fpstune.adaptive_maximum.tooltip: The automatic limit never goes above this.
button.fpstune.show_more.tooltip: Show or hide fine-tuning for nearby particles and automatic adjustment.
button.fpstune.reset_tab.tooltip: Put this tab back to its defaults. Nothing is saved until you press Done.
option.fpstune.toggle_feedback.tooltip: What you see when you press F6 to turn FPS Tune on or off.
message.fpstune.name: FPS Tune
message.fpstune.summary.vanilla: Minecraft looks and runs as normal
